## MODL Outdoors

##### MODL Outdoors: Elevating Outdoor Adventures

  * __ MODL Outdoors is a dedicated and impactful outdoor gear partner.
  * __ MODL Outdoors made a significant impact as an exhibitor at the National Order of the Arrow Conference, attended by over 8,000 Scouting honor society members and leaders.
  * __ Through strategic partnerships with local councils, MODL Outdoors ensures that thousands of Scouts across America have access to top-quality gear. These collaborations help equip Scouts with the tools they need for their outdoor adventures, fostering a deeper connection with nature and Scouting values.
  * __ To further integrate their support, MODL Outdoors offers their products for sale in the Scout Shop, making it easy for Scouts and their families to purchase reliable and innovative gear. This accessibility ensures that Scouts are always prepared for their next adventure.

  * [ __ MODL Outdoors Sponsored Aaron on Scouting Blog Post ](https://blog.scoutingmagazine.org/2024/05/07/modls-infinity-tool-provides-countless-uses-for-camp-and-beyond/)
  * [ __ Scout Shop ](https://www.scoutshop.org/cs-modl-infinity-tool-660099.html)
